title: Decode Ways
statement: A maps to 1 through Z maps to 26. Given a string of digits, count how many ways it can be decoded back into letters. A leading zero is never valid, so 06 does not decode as 6.
hints: Same shape as Climbing Stairs, but each step has to be legal.
ways[i] counts decodings of the first i characters. You extend by one digit when it is not 0, and by two digits when they form 10 to 26.
ways[i] = (single digit valid ? ways[i-1] : 0) + (pair valid ? ways[i-2] : 0). A string starting with 0 has zero decodings.
